title: Cyberdeception Atlas: Source-Bounded Corpus and Evidence Architecture
description: Versioned public corpus, evidence model, reproducible analysis, and worked reporting-schema evaluation for defensive cyber deception. Release candidate v2026.10 contains 190 source-linked records and 24 single-reviewer full-text readings and explicitly separates review depth from evidence quality. It is a curated corpus, not a claim of exhaustive worldwide coverage.
